question: What immense wealth is insufficient compared to giving the kaula teaching?
premises: One might possess vast accumulated wealth
That wealth could fill an ocean with jewels
Such wealth is contrasted with the teaching
inference: Even wealth enough to fill the ocean with jewels is not comparable to this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear form; reading tentative
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels...
